root_types.Entry002.arithmeticSupply_exists_conduct:
∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (f : ℕ) (hf : 0 < f),
  ∃ R,
    ∀ v ∉ (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯).finitePart.support,
      ClassFieldTheory.FinitePrimeSplitsCompletely K (↥↑R.extension) v →
        ∃ A,
          Ideal.span {(Entry002.conductorOrderToIntegers K f) A} = v.asIdeal ∧
            ↑f ∣ (Entry002.conductorOrderToIntegers K f) A - 1
root_types.Entry002.arithmeticSupply_exists_ray_ext:
∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (m : ClassFieldTheory.RayClassModulus K),
  ∃ R,
    ∀ v ∉ m.finitePart.support,
      ClassFieldTheory.FinitePrimeSplitsCompletely K (↥↑R.extension) v ↔
        ∃ x a,
          ↑a = ↑x ∧
            Ideal.span {a} = v.asIdeal ∧
              ClassFieldTheory.IsRayCongruent m x ∧
                (toPrincipalIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K) x = ClassFieldTheory.finitePrimeFractionalIdeal v
root_types.Entry002.arithmeticSupply_integral_princ:
∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (x : Kˣ) (I : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) ↑x = ↑I →
    ∃ a, ↑a = ↑x ∧ Ideal.span {a} = I

∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (f : ℕ) (hf : 0 < f)
  (R : ClassFieldTheory.RayClassFieldRealization K (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯)),
  ∀ v ∉ (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯).finitePart.support,

        Ideal.span {(Entry002.conductorOrderToIntegers K f) A} = v.asIdeal ∧

∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (f : ℕ) (hf : 0 < f)
  (R : ClassFieldTheory.RayClassFieldRealization K (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯))
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (p : ℕ)
  [v.asIdeal.LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑p})],
  v.asIdeal.inertiaDeg ℤ = 1 →
    v ∉ (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯).finitePart.support →
      ClassFieldTheory.FinitePrimeSplitsCompletely K (↥↑R.extension) v →
        ∃ A,
          Ideal.span {(Entry002.conductorOrderToIntegers K f) A} = v.asIdeal ∧
            ((Algebra.norm ℤ) A).natAbs = p ∧ ↑f ∣ (Entry002.conductorOrderToIntegers K f) A - 1

∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K],
  Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 →
    ∀ (f : ℕ) (hf : 0 < f) (τ : Gal(K/ℚ)),
      τ ≠ AlgEquiv.refl →
        ∀ (R : ClassFieldTheory.RayClassFieldRealization K (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯))
          (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (p : ℕ),
          Nat.Prime p →
            ∀ [v.asIdeal.LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑p})],
              v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx ℤ = 1 →
                v.asIdeal.inertiaDeg ℤ = 1 →
                  v ∉ (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯).finitePart.support →
                    ClassFieldTheory.FinitePrimeSplitsCompletely K (↥↑R.extension) v →
                      ∃ A,
                        Ideal.span {(Entry002.conductorOrderToIntegers K f) A} = v.asIdeal ∧
                          ((Algebra.norm ℤ) A).natAbs = p ∧
                            ((Algebra.norm ℤ) ((Entry002.arithmeticSupply_conductorAutomorphism K f τ) A)).natAbs = p ∧
                              ∃ ψPlus ψMinus,
                                Function.Surjective ⇑ψPlus ∧
                                  Function.Surjective ⇑ψMinus ∧
                                    (∀ (x : ↥(Entry002.conductorOrder K f)), ψPlus x = 0 ↔ A ∣ x) ∧
                                      (∀ (x : ↥(Entry002.conductorOrder K f)),
                                          ψMinus x = 0 ↔
                                            (Entry002.arithmeticSupply_conductorAutomorphism K f τ) A ∣ x) ∧
                                        ∀ (x : ↥(Entry002.conductorOrder K f)),
                                          ψPlus x = 0 ∧ ψMinus x = 0 ↔ ∃ y, x = ↑p • y

root_types.Entry002.integralRayModulus:
(K : Type) →
  [inst : Field K] →
    [inst_1 : NumberField K] → (d : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) → d ≠ 0 → ClassFieldTheory.RayClassModulus K
root_types.Entry002.integralRayModulus_apply:
∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (d : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (hd : d ≠ 0)
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  (Entry002.integralRayModulus K d hd).finitePart v =
    (FractionalIdeal.count K v
        (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) ↑d)).toNat
root_types.Entry002.integralRayModulus_conductor_li:
∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (f : ℕ) (hf : 0 < f) (x : Kˣ) (a : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K),
  ↑a = ↑x →
    ClassFieldTheory.IsRayCongruent (Entry002.integralRayModulus K ↑f ⋯) x →
      ∃ A, (Entry002.conductorOrderToIntegers K f) A = a
root_types.Entry002.integralRayModulus_dvd_sub_one:
∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (d : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (hd : d ≠ 0) (x : Kˣ)
  (a : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K),
  ↑a = ↑x → ClassFieldTheory.IsRayCongruent (Entry002.integralRayModulus K d hd) x → d ∣ a - 1
root_types.Entry002.integralRayModulus_valuation:
∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (d : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (hd : d ≠ 0)
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation K v) ↑d =
    WithZero.exp (-↑((Entry002.integralRayModulus K d hd).finitePart v))

  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (n : ℕ) (x : Kˣ)
